I replied to Marcus in his DM (DSHARED0001), threaded under his message. I said I'll keep the possible Door 23 change between us and won't repeat it or write it into notes or trackers.

- **First attempt failed:** I tried to DM him by name, but the directory returned "no member Marcus Lindqvist". I posted straight into his DM channel instead.
- **Brain lookup:** A GBrain search shows the store he means is probably Pine Crossing. In a June 9 #central-team chat, a morning receiver there said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. I didn't name the store in my reply and haven't shared it anywhere else.
- **Nothing saved:** I kept the rumour out of GBrain and my own memory, since writing it down would mean repeating it outside his DM.
